description: This file declares the interface and class definitions for the internal media pipeline server component within the Rialto media framework. It includes factory classes for creating media pipeline instances, and the main class 'MediaPipelineServerInternal' which manages media playback, source attachment, and related operations, with methods for controlling and querying media state.

classes.name: MediaPipelineServerInternalFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating instances of media pipeline and internal server objects.

classes.name: MediaPipelineServerInternal
classes.description: Main class implementing the internal media pipeline server, managing media playback, source attachment, and related operations.

methods.name: createMediaPipeline
methods.description: Creates a media pipeline instance for a given client and video requirements.

methods.name: createMediaPipelineServerInternal
methods.description: Creates an internal media pipeline server instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new factory instance.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads media of a specified type, MIME type, and URL.

methods.name: attachSource
methods.description: Attaches a media source to the pipeline.

methods.name: removeSource
methods.description: Removes a media source by ID.

methods.name: allSourcesAttached
methods.description: Checks if all sources are attached.

methods.name: addSegment
methods.description: Adds a media segment for playback.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns a weak pointer to the media pipeline client.

methods.name: notifyNeedMediaData
methods.description: Notifies that media data is needed.

methods.name: clearActiveRequestsCache
methods.description: Clears the cache of active requests.

methods.name: invalidateActiveRequests
methods.description: Invalidates active requests for a media source type.
